observed.caption: An illuminated Artcaffè Market neon sign glows on a brick wall in an indoor corridor with easels and potted plants.
observed.description: A textured light-brown brick wall occupies the center of the image with a glowing neon sign mounted on it, the upper line in white-blue and the lower line in green. To the left is a brick arch with a black metal tiered stand holding three potted green plants in white pots. In the foreground and midground along the wall are two wooden A-frame easels holding light-colored display boards on a tiled floor that is light along the wall and dark further into the corridor. In the background a tall arched brick doorway leads further inside, and on the far right wall a wheeled gray cleaning utility cart with bins sits near cleaning tools. The lighting is dim and artificial, dominated by the neon glow reflecting on the wall and floor.
